chapter_title: How to Find and Fix the Causes of Your Bad Habits
narration_script: Every behavior has a surface level craving and a deeper underlying motive. You want a cigarette not because you need nicotine but because you crave relief from stress. You check your phone not because you need information but because you crave social connection. The key is to find the root cause of your bad habits and address that directly. You cannot eliminate bad habits entirely. But you can replace them with better ones that satisfy the same underlying motive. This is the process of habit shifting.
